title: Imputed Righteousness
definition: Imputed Righteousness is the crediting of Christ's righteousness to believers so they stand accepted before God.
summary: Imputed Righteousness is the crediting of Christ's righteousness to believers by faith.
christFocus: Jesus Christ obeyed perfectly and becomes the righteousness of those who trust in Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Imputed righteousness means God counts Christ's righteousness to believers through faith. Scripture teaches that sinners do not stand before God dressed in their own moral record, but in the obedience of Jesus.

This doctrine is not about pretending sinners were righteous in themselves. It is about a real legal standing given by grace because Christ truly obeyed where sinners failed.

Jesus is not only the One who removes guilt; He is the righteous One whose obedience is credited to His people. In Him, believers are accepted before God.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because many people live under the pressure of proving they are enough for God. Imputed righteousness gives assurance that acceptance rests on Christ's perfect obedience, not the believer's unstable performance.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Stop building your peace with God on spiritual scorekeeping. Trust the righteousness of Christ, worship Him for covering you completely, and teach the Gospel in a way that makes His obedience central.
